panel.name: plus_photoscreen_left
panel.string: The parcel you are on. Click for About Land.
Sunrise, noon, sunset or midnight, as World > Environment sets them. The sky's card brings back the land's sky.
The sky in use. Click to choose from the list of skies (All, Favorites, Recent); click again to close it.
The water in use. Click to choose from the list of waters (All, Favorites, Recent); click again to close it.
Back to the land's own (the region or parcel's environment)
Click (or Return) to use it. The star (or Shift+Return) adds it to or removes it from your favorites, shared with the photo tools.
Not in your inventory (deleted, in the trash, or not loaded yet). The star removes it from the list.
Not in your inventory (deleted, in the trash, or not loaded yet). Newer ones push it out of the list.
No favorites yet. Add one with the star of a row in All.
and [COUNT] more (search in the photo tools)
Nothing used yet. What you choose here or in the photo tools is listed.
The favorites are full. Remove one with its star first.
That sky or water is not in your inventory any more.
Your HUD attachments in the picture. As they were when you leave the photo screen.
Smoke, sparkles and the like. Shown again when you leave the photo screen.
Turns the animation overrider off so it does not change your pose while you shoot
The AO back on if it was stopped here, the world going on again and the eyes as normal
Opens the poser, where poses are loaded and saved
No poses saved yet. Poses are made and saved in the poser.
Hold it on a side to orbit the camera around what it looks at; faster toward the edge. The dot in the middle puts the camera back.
Hold it on a side to move the camera up, down, left or right; faster toward the edge. The dot in the middle puts the camera back.
Drag up to come closer, down to go farther (the arrow keys too).
Tilts the picture sideways: + is to the right, 0 is level. The same tilt as the photo tools' slider.
Tilt the camera to the left (hold to keep tilting)
Tilt the camera to the right (hold to keep tilting)
How far the camera is tilted (degrees, + is to the right)
Opens Camera Position, where the camera's place and what it looks at are typed in as numbers.
The camera leaves the avatar and flies free. [KEY] also turns it on and off.
W A S D fly, Space / C up and down, the arrow keys turn, the wheel sets the speed, Q / E tilt.
W A S D fly, Space / C up and down. Hold the right button to look around; the wheel sets the speed, Q / E tilt.
W A S D fly, Space / C up and down. The mouse looks around (Alt for the cursor); the wheel sets the speed, Q / E tilt.
Seven quality levels, Low to Ultra (the same as the quality slider in Preferences and the photo tools' Quality tab). The viewer stops for a moment while a level is applied.
